skills.name: pipeline-run
skills.description: Run the full cargo-cicd pipeline: check, test changed, git status, workspace doctor, evidence doctor
skills.command: cargo make check && cargo cicd test changed && cargo cicd git status && cargo cicd workspace doctor && cargo cicd evidence doctor
skills.trigger: When user wants to run the full CI pipeline locally or verify workspace is ready to push

skills.name: evidence-doctor
skills.description: Emit and inspect process evidence, then invoke wasm4pm oracle for adjudication
skills.trigger: When user wants to check evidence gate status, verify wpm oracle, or prepare for release

skills.name: test-all
skills.description: Run all test suites including invariants, CLI, feature projection, autonomic policies, and git phase closure
skills.command: cargo test --test invariants && cargo test --test cli && cargo test --test feature_projection && cargo test --test autonomic_policies && cargo test --test git_phase_closure
skills.trigger: When user wants comprehensive test coverage beyond just cargo make test

skills.name: check-workspace
skills.description: Run full workspace health check: doctor, validate, list members, git status, policies
skills.command: cargo cicd workspace doctor && cargo cicd workspace validate && cargo cicd workspace list && cargo cicd git status
skills.trigger: When user wants a complete workspace health assessment before committing or pushing

skills.name: release-gate
skills.description: Run complete release gate: tests, invariants, evidence gate, workspace health — must all pass before tagging
skills.command: cargo make test && cargo test --test invariants && cargo test --test wasm4pm_evidence_gate && cargo cicd workspace doctor && cargo cicd evidence doctor
skills.trigger: When user wants to verify the workspace is ready for a version release, or to check all gates before tagging
